index.title:
Stanford AI / ML / Agent
course map
index.lede: Stanford's AI courses are scattered across CS, EE, STATS, MS&E, CME, AA, PSYCH, and SymSys. This map turns them into one browsable path: in-depth overviews of the core courses, a full course table, and six learning paths.
index.pilot: Full English edition: {total} core + 70 related courses, plus paths, semester, prerequisites, and Bilibili.
index.about_body: All 125 course pages have an English version, translated from the Chinese notes in this repo. Official course titles, descriptions, units, terms, and instructors come from Stanford ExploreCourses. Related-course pages keep the official record and a short English one-liner.
index.footnote: Unofficial map. Course information is based on Stanford ExploreCourses (2026–27) and course sites; always check the official syllabus.
